title: Project Atlas M1 Daily Learning Loop
purpose: Transform Learn-it into a local personal learning system that builds an explainable 5, 15 or 30 minute session from observed learner evidence, guides the session, rewards pedagogically useful progress and resumes reliably on desktop and Android without any runtime LLM or network dependency.

contractAmendment.noIntBefore: four new ACCEPTED_HEAD verdicts and a written freeze of the exact four product SHAs

included: deterministic local recommendation and session planning

ATLAS-LEARNING.mission: Implement pure evidence interpretation, recommendation ranking, explanation reason codes, deterministic session planning and pure reward projection behind contracts 0.3.

ATLAS-EXPERIENCE.mission: Implement isolated Today, guided-session, summary, knowledge-map and pedagogical-reward presentation without redefining learning semantics.
obligations: display assistance only after CORE persistence confirmation
advance only after CORE transaction confirmation
faithfully display exact plan and derived rewards
no scoring event claim reward or activity choice in UI

ATLAS-CORE.mission: Implement immutable events, scoring provenance, qualified identities, isolated local storage, controlled clock, export/import and resume primitives behind data-only interfaces.

ATLAS-CONTENT.mission: Produce two representative Atlas-ready v2 kits and authoring checks with explicit objectives, practice, correction, validation and classified non-planifiable transfer coverage.
obligations: no transfer claim or transfer action in M1

independentQa.mission: Challenge the exact integrated candidate with deterministic, temporal, interruption, invalid-content, reward-integrity and no-network scenarios without modifying product files.
obligations: exact content revision and artifact binding

integration.mission: Compose exact accepted lane heads into one candidate, reconcile shared composition and build inputs, and run the full matrix without silently repairing lane-owned product files.
integration.promotionGate: independent QA plus desktop and Android human validation of the exact candidate artifact

invariants: No runtime LLM, remote API call, secret or network dependency is introduced.
The same history, content, controlled clock and engine version produce the same normalized session plan and deterministic planId.
Learning events and scored executions are immutable, kind-closed and identity conflicts fail closed.
ObjectiveEvidence is recalculable only from accepted pedagogical events and scored executions.
Practice, correction, validation, maintenance and classified transfer remain distinct.
Every recommendation exposes reason codes from the frozen nine-code M1 registry.
One exact preferred activity determines the advertised duration and the plan never substitutes it.
Rewards are a pure LEARNING projection, use the closed H1 priority and never reuse the same evidence.
The v2 kit schema remains backward compatible outside the Atlas gate.
Atlas state 0.2 is rejected before every write and is never migrated heuristically.
scoredExecutions, learningEvents and resumeStates commit atomically.
The four development lanes have no overlapping owned file path.
INT never creates or repairs semantics.
The exact tested HTML artifact is the artifact proposed for promotion.
No autonomous merge, direct main write or release publication is authorized.
requiredEvidence: The contract PR contains only the five contract-lane paths.
The frozen A1-A12 and H1-H5 register maps to explicit closed contract text and fixtures.
Schema syntax and JSON syntax pass.
At least one pre-0.3 non-Atlas kit remains schema-valid.
Atlas gates reject missing duration, invalid claims, naked references, identity divergence, unknown autonomous assistance and state 0.2.
Each corrected lane starts from the exact accepted contract merge commit and changes only its allowlist.
Developer tests and independent QA remain separate.
Two clean builds are byte-for-byte identical.
The exact tested HTML artifact is downloadable.
Desktop and Android human validation pass before promotion.
adversarialTests: Reject any runtime network request or LLM integration.
Reject unknown contract fields, enums and noncanonical timestamps.
Reject validation credit originating from practice, assisted or unknown evidence.
Reject a correction without an exact correctsEventId to a same-scope incorrect practice event.
Reject a session plan without a preferred activity or with planId and planDigest divergence.
Reject an activity longer than the selected session budget without substitution.
Reject stale, cross-artifact, cross-kit, cross-course, cross-objective or cosmetic independence claims.
Reject a reward backed by missing, foreign, duplicated, reused or semantically inadmissible evidence.
Reject a schema change that adds a correction role or a new activity type.
Reject Atlas state 0.2 before any write.
Reject an integrated candidate whose source manifest or artifact differs from accepted heads.
independentReview: Issue #130 is the single M1 authority.
ATLAS_M1_ARBITRATION_FROZEN_V1 is the final normative authority.
QA remains independent from all four development lanes.
Governor review is required only for contract or scope changes, irreversible migration, candidate acceptance and promotion.
rollback: Revert the integrated Atlas M1 candidate and discard only its isolated learnit.atlas.m1.v2 storage. Preserve learnit.atlas.m1.v1 unchanged. The promoted Learning Loop V2 baseline 06c06d5ea0cadcb3cb2084769ff5ada4d0fe0a35 and its exact artifact remain available.
